long_biography.plain_text:
Urdaneta entered direct selling as a teenager in Venezuela and rose through the distributor ranks before creating his own beauty-products venture. He founded L’EUDINE Global in 2001, bringing an operating model based on person-to-person sales, distributor development and family participation into a business serving Latin American markets.

After relocating to Miami, Urdaneta and his family launched Alcora Corporation’s American platform. He later co-founded MONAT with his son Rayner in 2014, applying the same channel to premium haircare and later beauty and wellness categories. Corporate manufacturing, product development and distribution businesses were organised beneath the private group, while Rayner assumed the chief executive role and Luis continued as chairman.
long_biography.html:
Urdaneta entered direct selling as a teenager in Venezuela and rose through the distributor ranks before creating his own beauty-products venture. He founded L’EUDINE Global in 2001, bringing an operating model based on person-to-person sales, distributor development and family participation into a business serving Latin American markets.

After relocating to Miami, Urdaneta and his family launched Alcora Corporation’s American platform. He later co-founded MONAT with his son Rayner in 2014, applying the same channel to premium haircare and later beauty and wellness categories. Corporate manufacturing, product development and distribution businesses were organised beneath the private group, while Rayner assumed the chief executive role and Luis continued as chairman.
